title: GTA 6 Release Date: Original GTA Creators Haven't Played It
description: GTA 6 release date is November 19 on PS5 and Xbox, and even original GTA creators Dave Jones and Brian Baglow haven't played it yet, per Gizbot.

body.text: The GTA 6 release date is November 19 for PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S, and according to Gizbot, even the people who helped start the franchise have not played it. Dave Jones, co-creator of the original Grand Theft Auto, and Brian Baglow, its original writer and publicist, told the BBC they are still waiting to see what Rockstar Games has built. It shows just how tightly Rockstar is guarding its biggest game yet.
Why the original GTA creators have no early access

Gizbot describes Rockstar as a studio known for keeping upcoming projects under wraps, and GTA 6 seems to be no exception. In the BBC interview, Jones said he and Baglow were waiting to see what Rockstar had created. When Baglow was asked if he had played the game, he shook his head.
He did not sound bothered, though. According to the report, Baglow has already pre-ordered GTA 6, so he will be in the same queue as everyone else.
The source does not give an official reason for the lack of access. It simply notes that GTA 6 is being treated as a separate project from the games Jones and Baglow worked on.

Jones was part of DMA Design, the Dundee-based studio behind the first Grand Theft Auto in 1997. Gizbot notes that the game began as a racing project called Race'n'Chase before turning into a crime-focused open-world title.

The team wanted to stand apart from regular racing games. A key idea was letting players leave their vehicles, steal other cars and explore on foot. The developers also thought about making players police officers, but decided that playing the criminal would be more fun.
GTA 6 release date, platforms and what to expect
Here is what the Gizbot report confirms about the launch and the game itself:

items: Launch date: November 19 on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S.
PC: no release date has been announced yet.
Setting: Leonida, a fictional US state inspired by Florida, with Vice City returning in a new setting and a much larger world.
Story: two protagonists, Jason Duval and Lucia Caminos. Lucia is the first female protagonist in a mainline GTA game in the modern 3D era.
Download size: reports about the physical edition suggest around 230GB, while images shared online hint the pre-load could be about 212GB.

body.text: Treat the download figures with caution. They come from reports and shared images rather than an official Rockstar announcement in the source.

With launch day close, the next things to watch are the pre-load going live and any word on a PC release date, which is still missing. If you are playing on console, clear storage now, because a download of over 200GB could take a while on many Indian broadband connections. And if Jones and Baglow share their thoughts after they finally get to play, that will be worth a read for long-time GTA fans.

faqs.q: What is the GTA 6 release date?
faqs.a: According to Gizbot, GTA 6 launches on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S on November 19. A PC release date has not been announced yet.

faqs.q: Have the original GTA creators played GTA 6?
faqs.a: No. Gizbot reports that Dave Jones, co-creator of the original Grand Theft Auto, and Brian Baglow, its original writer and publicist, have not received early access, as they said in a BBC interview.

faqs.q: How big is the GTA 6 download size?
faqs.a: Gizbot says reports about the physical edition point to roughly 230GB, though images shared online suggest the actual pre-load could be closer to 212GB. Neither figure is officially confirmed in the source.
